commit: fix(config): read configuration files that start with a UTF-8 BOM

truth.description: readFile drops a leading BOM only when its caller passes stripBom, and only loadConfig passes it, so the package.json filter in config-searcher.js still calls loadConfigFromPackageJson without options, parse-json throws on the BOM, the filter's catch returns false, and config search silently skips a BOM-prefixed package.json with a prettier key and resolves to a parent config or none.

distractions.why: U+FEFF is a single UTF-16 code unit, so comparing charAt(0) and slicing one character removes exactly the BOM and never splits a surrogate pair.
